summary: Iteration 13 – real Stripe payments with escrow/split, Match Registry, logistics rate-card engine. Backend: 7/7 existing + 11/11 new extended tests pass (checkout, owner-only status, cancel/stock, escrow hold→confirm→payout pending_connect, dispute→admin release/refund with audit, settings bounds 1-60, auto-release, payouts/mine, Connect 503 Italian, matches role-scoped + chain valid, rate-card CRUD/permissions, instant-quote no-match/forbidden, book + shipment checkout amount = carrier+fee). 2 extra regression tests reproduce real bugs (paid-after-cancel resurrects order; shipment delivered before payment → escrow stuck). REAL end-to-end Stripe hosted checkout completed twice with card 4242 (checkout → checkout.stripe.com → /pagamento 'Pagamento riuscito' → order 'In garanzia'). Frontend: all requested flows verified on 390x844 (buyer Da pagare/Paga ora/Annulla, dispute sheet, confirm delivery, cancelled return page, producer instant quote → book → Pagamento trasporto → Stripe redirect €218.16, producer/logistics Incassi + Collega conto toast, Tariffari list + create, tracking POD required, admin Pagamenti in garanzia release w/ note, Registro Match 'Registro integro'). Main gaps: Stripe refunds fail with emergent key but UI shows 'Rimborsato'; stale 'Pagamento simulato' copy; edge-case escrow bugs. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Sheet has no KeyboardAvoidingView (native keyboard will cover inputs).

critical.issue: Cancelling an awaiting_payment order restores stock but the Stripe Checkout session stays open (valid ~24h). If the buyer then pays, _fulfill unconditionally sets status=paid + escrow held → order resurrected with stock already restored (oversell, ghost escrow). Reproduced by tests/test_iter13_payments_ext.py::test_paid_after_cancel_does_not_resurrect_order. Fix: in _fulfill update only {_id, status:'awaiting_payment'}; if no match flag tx 'needs_refund' (attempt refund/notify admin); also mark previous sessions expired on cancel.

Carrier can mark a shipment 'delivered' (with POD) before the producer pays. Checkout is still allowed afterwards; _fulfill sets escrow held but release_shipment only runs on the delivered tracking event (now blocked: 'Spedizione già consegnata') and there is no auto-release for shipments → funds held forever, no carrier payout. Reproduced by test_shipment_delivered_before_payment_escrow_not_stuck. Fix: in _fulfill(shipment) release immediately if tracking_status=='delivered'/pod exists, or block delivered until paid.

Real Stripe refund via raw stripe SDK fails with the emergent test key (backend log: 'Rimborso Stripe non riuscito ...: Invalid response body from API: 404 page not found') even for a genuinely paid session → escrow.refund_status='manual_required', yet escrow.status/order.status become 'refunded' and BOTH admin console and buyer /buyer/ordini show 'Rimborsato'. refund_status is never surfaced in the frontend (no reference in app/ or src/). Money is NOT returned to the buyer while UI says it is.

minor.issue: awaiting_payment orders reserve stock indefinitely (21 unpaid orders currently in DB). Add a TTL sweep (e.g. 24h = Stripe session expiry) that cancels and restores stock.
Chain sequencing relies on in-process asyncio.Lock; with >1 worker a seq DuplicateKeyError falls into find_one by pair which returns None → match entry silently lost. Retry with next seq instead.
origin_region/destination_region are free text, not validated against REGIONS or '*'; a typo (e.g. 'Lombardia ' ok, 'Lombadia' not) creates a card that never matches any quote.
auto_release_at is frozen at hold time, so changing days only affects future payments; UI copy 'Rilascio automatico dopo N giorni' does not say this.

Full suite: 14 failures, of which 3 were test_payments_logistics failing only due to event-loop sharing with my new file (fixed by sharing LOOP). Remaining pre-existing: test_trade_durability x3 (monkeypatched _compute_market returns 2 values, code now unpacks 3: data, live, kb), test_trade_assistant market analysis x4, registration consent x3, regulatory center counts x1.

Orders/escrow items with escrow.refund_status='manual_required' show 'Rimborsato' to buyer and admin; add a distinct 'Rimborso da eseguire manualmente' state in admin/pagamenti.tsx and buyer/ordini.tsx
'Aggiorna stato' button still shown for delivered shipments; backend answers 422 'Spedizione già consegnata'. Hide when s.status==='delivered'. Reference: app/(app)/logistics/tracciamento.tsx:66

critical_code_review_comments: Amounts are always computed server-side (good); status endpoint scoped by user_id (good); _fulfill idempotent via processed flag (good)
release_order sets status='completed' – buyer badge shows 'Rilasciato' (escrow label) which is seller-centric wording for a buyer; consider 'Completato' for buyer
admin_escrow loads up to 200 orders + 200 shipments + 200 payouts without pagination
get_settings returns doc with _id 'default' converted to id – fine
Match Registry: B2C consumer orders also create introduction entries (consumer↔producer) – confirm this is intended for the introduction commission

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && export MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/STRIPE_API_KEY from .env, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:8001 (or public URL) and pytest tests/test_payments_logistics.py tests/test_iter13_payments_ext.py -n 0. Both files share one asyncio LOOP (the app motor client binds to the first loop) – keep that when adding tests that call routers.payments._fulfill. Real Stripe hosted checkout works in Playwright: fill #email, #cardNumber 4242..., #cardExpiry '12 / 34', #cardCvc, #billingName, #billingPostalCode, click .SubmitButton, then wait for **/pagamento**. Sheets animate – wait ~1.5s after opening before clicking buttons inside.
rca_of_issue: Paid-after-cancel: cancel_unpaid flips status and restores stock but leaves the Stripe session open; _fulfill's orders.update_one filter is {_id} only. Shipment stuck escrow: release_shipment is only triggered from add_tracking(delivered); _amount_for(shipment) does not check tracking_status and _fulfill(shipment) never checks for existing POD. Refund: stripe.Refund via the raw SDK isn't supported by the emergent proxy key (404 page not found) → exception swallowed → manual_required, but status still set to 'refunded'.
